author_derivative_interpretation.primary_representation: 20D ordered dynamic profile = 10 SCR bins + 10 SCL bins; preserve bin order; no early/late relabeling.

forbidden: using Valence, Liking, other reports, emotion category, or stimulus semantics to choose features/windows/tests
claiming these author 10x3-s stimulus derivatives measure rating-period physiology
opening raw GSR/PPG amplitude after exact_physio_eeg_sync_recovery exact-sync failure
opening Validation or Confirmation derivative values during source_gsr_dynamic_design/I/J Discovery work
post-hoc selection of individual GSR bins because they correlate with an outcome

heldout_policy.opening_condition: No held-out GSR derivative values may be opened unless >=1 DG1-DG3 primary is Holm-supported and its prespecified robustness gate passes in Discovery.

multiplicity: Holm correction jointly across DG1, DG2, DG3.

preprocessing_prespecified.iSCR_role: prespecified sensitivity only; not added to primary 20D family
preprocessing_prespecified.numeric_coercion: values opened only in discovery_source_gsr_materialization_qc after H source gate passes
preprocessing_prespecified.scaling: training-fold median/IQR; pooled fallback for zero IQR

DG1.permutation: 10000 within-participant label permutations preserving participant trial counts
DG1.question: Does the 20D stimulus-period GSR dynamic profile differ between fixed EEG trajectory families beyond context and acquisition order?
DG1.statistic: participant-balanced within-person multivariate profile contrast after nuisance adjustment

DG2.model: nested leave-one-participant-out ridge logistic regression; baseline nuisance-only vs full nuisance+20D GSR
DG2.permutation: 1000 participant-stratified label permutations with model selection repeated
DG2.question: Can dynamic GSR predict fixed trajectory family in an unseen person beyond context + acquisition_fraction?

DG3.question: Does the 20D stimulus-period GSR dynamic profile couple to the fixed continuous 6D EEG trajectory geometry beyond nuisance?

robustness_prespecified: SCR-only and SCL-only follow-ups only if their parent primary test is supported
iSCR-augmented sensitivity only after primary results are fixed
family numerical-label swap invariance for DG1/DG2
scope: Discovery-only author-provided stimulus-period dynamic GSR derivatives; rating-period physiology remains untested.
